title.narrative: UNICEF supports the government in improving maternal and child nutrition through key policy advancements such as evaluating the National Plan of Action for Nutrition. Efforts in legal and nutrition analyses, desk reviews, cost-benefit assessments and food marketing have strengthened evidence-based policymaking. Child growth initiatives have been strengthened through research in the Growth Monitoring and Promotion programme, while national efforts to promote breastfeeding and address childhood obesity have advanced through targeted policy dialogues. Key initiatives, such as school-based obesity intervention have shown potential for national scaling, while the Healthy Centralized Kitchen pilot supports Malaysia?s progress and contributed to the ASEAN framework.
